name: ai-finance-controller
description: AI Finance Controller - Unified financial source of truth, automated multi-gateway reconciliation, and AI exception investigator

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run prisma:setup && npm run seed
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.prisma:setup: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
